en: Sepia-toned photograph of a ruined brick building with a steeply pitched tiled roof and substantial buttresses. The walls are partially collapsed and overgrown with vegetation. The structure features bricked-up arched openings and pilaster-like projections along the façade. On the left, an adjoining, more massive masonry section ends in a flat top with a damaged sculptural figure above it. In the background at far left there appears to be a faint spire from another building or church and some low houses across an open field. The image has a clear border typical of early 20th‑century photographic postcards. No visible printed text appears on the front.
